name: Great Expectations
summary: Validate Ogun artifacts with Great Expectations Core inside a sandboxed Python code operator; with a GX Cloud token, results go to GX Cloud.

fields.name: access_token
fields.label: GX Cloud access token
fields.help: Created in GX Cloud. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: cloud_host
settings.label: GX Cloud API host
settings.help: Only for GX Cloud. Check the GX documentation for the host of your organization.

egress.note: GX Core needs no network access for data Ogun already holds. GX Cloud needs the host above.

notes: Ogun calls Great Expectations; it does not replace it. A workflow runs GX Core in the builtin python@1 code operator: out of process, sandboxed, referenced by content hash and approved by a person against the workflow hash. Ogun has no GX-specific operator. With a GX Cloud context, the GX library posts results itself.
